11  Vale’s Cobalt Business – May 2012 
Vale’s Base Metals Business 
 
 
 
Vale’s Base Metals business is headquartered in Toronto, Canada, with over 
25,000 employees and contractors around the world 
Base Metals products include: 
• Nickel  
• Copper 
• Cobalt 
• PGMs 
• Other precious metals

Vale Base Metals Operations  
North Atlantic Operations 
Sudbury, Ontario:  
•100+ year old mining and processing (smelting and 
refining) operation  
•One of the largest integrated mining operations in 
the world making high purity carbonyl nickel 
products 
 
Port Colborne, Ontario:  
•Facility for cobalt refining and precious metals 
upgrading  
•Commissioned in 1918 
 
Thompson, Manitoba:   
•Integrated nickel mining, milling, smelting and 
refining facility   
•Operating since 1961 - produces highest quality 
nickel plating product on the market 
 
Thompson Operations 
16 
Sudbury Operations 
Voisey’s Bay, Newfoundland & Labrador:   
•Single open-pit nickel-copper-cobalt sulphide mine - 
feeds a dedicated mill and concentrator  
•Located in coastal Labrador and has been 
operating since 2005.   
 
Long Harbour, Newfoundland & Labrador: 
•Construction of a hydrometallurgical facility 
underway  
•Capacity of 50,000tpy of nickel and associated 
copper and cobalt that will process Voisey’s Bay 
concentrate 
Voisey’s Bay Mine 
Construction at Long Harbour 
North Atlantic Operations (cont.) 
17 
Acton, England:  
•Built in 1924, one of the world's major refiners 
of platinum-group metals (PGMs) platinum, 
palladium, rhodium, ruthenium and iridium, as 
well as gold and silver  
 
 
Clydach, Wales:  
•Refinery produces approximately 40,000 
tonnes per year of high purity carbonyl nickel 
pellets and powders 
 
 
Clydach refinery 
Acton Refinery 
North Atlantic Operations (cont.) 
18

PT Vale Indonesia, Indonesia:  
•Largest nickel laterite smelter in the world  
•Ore from open-pit mines is processed into a 
nickel matte intermediate product for shipment to 
refineries in Japan 
 
Vale New Caledonia, South Pacific:  
•Vertically integrated nickel refinery for processing 
of limonitic ores  
•Annual capacity of 57,000 tonnes of contained 
nickel and 4,500 tpy cobalt   
•Majority of the nickel produced is in the form of 
nickel oxide (NiO), with the balance being nickel 
hydroxide cake (NHC) 
Processing plant, Indonesia 
NHC product at VNC

Matsuzaka, Japan:  
•Plant processes matte supplied by PTVI to produce intermediate and refined 
nickel products 
 
Dalian, China:   
•Produces utility nickel for local stainless steel industry using nickel oxide sinter to 
be supplied primarily by Vale New Caledonia 
 
TNRC, Taiwan:  
•Produces utility nickel for the domestic market; tonimet and nickel oxide feed is 
sourced primarily from Vale Japan 
 
KNC, Korea:  
•Vale is a minority shareholder in Korea Nickel Corporation (KNC) which owns a 
utility nickel plant in Korea 
 
 
 
 
Asia Pacific & Africa Operations (cont.) 
20 
Onça Puma 
Lubambe, Zambia:  
•Underground mine project being developed 
through a joint venture with African Minerals 
•Achieved first production in October 2012, and 
will produce 45,000 tpy of copper in concentrate 
 
 
 
 
Asia Pacific & Africa Operations (cont.) 
21 
South Atlantic Operations (Page 1 of 2) 
Sossego, Brazil:   
•Vale’s first open-pit copper mine in the South 
Atlantic  
•Facility consists of a mine, mill and concentrator 
•Concentrate contains on average 120,000 tpy of 
copper, as well as 104,000 oz of gold per year 
 
Salobo, Brazil:  
•Largest copper deposit ever discovered in Brazil 
•Greenfield, open-pit mining project with a mill and 
concentrator, producing a copper concentrate  
•Project being developed in two phases, with 
Salobo I producing 100,000 tpy of copper in 
concentrate, and Salobo II doubling production   
 
 
Sossego mine site 
Salobo mine site 
22 
Tres Valles copper cathodes 
Onca Puma Operations 
Onça Puma, Brazil:  
•Vale’s first nickel project in Brazil 
•Plant consists of two parallel rotary kiln – electric 
furnace lines 
•First nickel produced in April 2011, production 
restart anticipated Q4 2013 
 
 
 
 
Tres Valles, Chile:  
•Vale’s first project in Chile 
•Operation consists of two copper oxide mines, 
and a solvent extraction and electrowinning (SX-
EW) plant capable of producing 18,500 tpy of 
copper cathodes
